findings.title: Healthcheck runtime scales with number of probes because timeouts are applied per probe sequentially
findings.evidence: The endpoint claims to probe dependencies with timeouts, but it executes every probe one after another using the full timeout each time. With multiple slow or blackholed dependencies, total latency becomes N × timeout_seconds, so a default configuration with several probes can block /healthz for many seconds and cause upstream health checks to fail even though each individual probe respected its timeout.
findings.recommendation: Enforce a total deadline for the whole healthcheck, or run probes concurrently and bound the overall request time. At minimum, document and test that timeout_seconds is per-probe rather than an overall budget.
